metadata.description: Agent skill for the ktalk CLI — the Kontur.Talk API from the terminal

plugins.name: ktalk
plugins.description: Teaches the agent when and how to reach for the ktalk CLI. Commands are grouped per API tag (recordings, rooms, meetings, reports, users, roles, webhooks, stats, surveys, kiosks, calendar-servers, deepfake, api-keys); the skill makes the agent read `ktalk --help` and `ktalk <group> <command> --help` first, then adds what the help does not cover: env-var auth, cursor pagination, JSON output, transcript --format text, token scopes, and built-in 429 handling.
